audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive facts are absent: Electrical Surge only adds its extra Mark of the Storm to targets that are ALREADY marked, Lightning Rush passes through units so minions never body-block his approach, and Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank while Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'adds another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked'; E 'enabling him to pass through units'; R cooldown 120 flat; Aurora R 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: Deny the first mark and the stun chain never starts — his W cannot open on you. Do not trade ults at rank 1: his R is back 20s before yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block names Lightning Rush as the matchup-defining cooldown with no number, and never gives Slicing Maelstrom's 120s.
audit.why: Lightning Rush is 10s at rank 1 — far too short to be the punish window. The 120s ult is.
audit.corrected: Slicing Maelstrom 120s flat is the window; Lightning Rush is only 10s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says Aurora's W-leap and R rift make her 'untargetable' (three times in this matchup). Riot's text gives Across the Veil invisibility and gives Between Worlds no untargetability.
audit.why: Across the Veil: 'becoming invisible'. Between Worlds: damage, slow, and a teleport across the zone — nothing more.
audit.corrected: Vanish on the W leap; cross the rift with R. Never 'untargetable'.
